assetOrigin: Original procedural mesh, embedded PBR maps, skeleton and animation; no third-party mesh or texture inputs.

artDirection.silhouette: Short stylized girl, oversized head, ochre dress, cream apron, chestnut side-parted twin tails with red ribbons and a round bomb held at the chest.
artDirection.hair: 197 independent scalp-hugging ribbons and tapered locks, continuous matte crown, side part, irregular eye-clearing bangs, three-segment twin tails, blended joint weights and delayed follow-through.
artDirection.face: Large eyes, separate gaze and eyelid bones, asymmetric smile, blush and natural head counter-motion.
artDirection.motion: Breathing, weight shift, delayed hair inertia, gaze, blinking and relaxed asymmetric rest pose reduce puppet stiffness.
artDirection.limbs: Continuous three-bone skinned arm and leg meshes blend across UpperArm/Forearm/Hand and Thigh/Shin/Foot so elbows, knees and ankles stay connected through every clip.
artDirection.bomb: HeldBomb and ThrownBomb are visual bones; explosion, damage and authoritative hit timing remain scene/server responsibilities.

standardization.coordinateNote: No horizontal Root.position motion in any clip; walk is in place.

rig.type: glTF SkinnedMesh skeleton with baked TRS animation tracks

clips.name: idle
clips.semantic: idle with breathing, gaze, blinking and hair inertia

clips.name: throw
clips.semantic: attackSwing: lift, overhead throw, bomb release and visual projectile

integration.renderer: sRGB output, ACES Filmic tone mapping, optional environment and shadows
integration.runtimeRegistration: Not performed; production CharacterRig integration remains a separate task.
